reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "The unused Helm option `proxy.sidecarImageRegex` has been removed", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: The option was unused, so removing it has no operational effect; any value set for it is no longer a recognised option.

proposed.statement: The unused Helm value proxy.sidecarImageRegex has been removed in Cilium 1.16.0.
